videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
videos.description: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
videos.description: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
videos.description: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

videos.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
videos.description: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess loves country hams and there's no better place to visit than Benton's--a family-run business that's been perfecting curing and aging techniques for over 50 years.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

videos.title: Hardcore Carnivore
videos.description: Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

videos.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
videos.description: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

videos.description: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

videos.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
videos.description: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: A lifelong outdoorsman and chef, Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking wild food over an open fire, creating delicious and easy meals, while sharing tips for sourcing, butchering and preparing game meat and fish.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: From a crispy-edged duck smash tacos piled with pickled greens to a traditional Danish Christmas roast with sweet-and-sour cabbage, potatoes and rich pan gravy, Andrew shows just how versatile duck can be.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Andrew makes two festive seafood dishes built for holiday entertaining, smoky West African jollof rice topped with grilled shrimp and scallops, and tender crab tamales served Christmas-style with complementary red and green salsas.

videos.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
videos.description: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

videos.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
